feeds.title: New Darlings
feeds.description: We are Robert & Christina: husband & wife, photo takers, and adventurers living in Phoenix, Arizona with our baby boy Oliver Lennon. New Darlings is a lifestyle journal dedicated to our life as a family in the desert.

feeds.title: Demi Bang
feeds.description: My name is Demi Bang. I'm a lifestyle blogger based in Scottsdale, Arizona. You'll find topics covering beauty, college/career, lifestyle, and travel!

feeds.title: Happily Pink
feeds.description: Your guide to all things travel, food and lifestyle related! The main goal of Happily Pink has always been to encourage others to seek out what makes them happiest in life.

feeds.title: AZ Big Media » Lifestyle
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Arizona Lifestyle. AZ Big Media serves as a compliment to its print publications and incorporates up-to-the-minute breaking news, compelling business stories, C-Level executive editorial profiles and much more.

feeds.title: All for the Memories
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog dedicated to creating memories through travel, DIY projects, crafts, and preserving those memories. Allison Waken loves finding new ways to create memories with and for her kids whether it's through vacations, road trips, everyday fun, or even projects around the house.

feeds.title: Wildish Jess Blog
feeds.description: Wildish Jess is a blog full of parenting, beauty, health, travel, and lifestyle tips for the everyday woman.

feeds.title: Zona Girl Magazine
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Tara Kirkpatrick. I'm a Southwest-based freelance writer and amateur fashion illustrator who loves to focus on fashion, style, and inspiring people. A former Associated Press reporter, my work has appeared in national newspapers, online publications, and regional magazines, but this little blog is my forever labor of love.

feeds.title: Curated by Kirsten
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog focusing on food, fashion, and travel written by a millennial with a global perspective. Follow along for travel itineraries, fashion inspiration, and delicious recipes on a budget. Kirsten is a part-time blogger and full-time accountant. Kirsten started 'this' blog back in 2013, when she was procrastinating studying for finals in her freshman year of college.

feeds.title: Like the Drum
feeds.description: Like the Drum is a Phoenix-based beauty and lifestyle blog by Timpani Porshay. Read product reviews, travel guides, and more. Timpani Porshay created LtD as a way to share her love of travel, beauty, style, and overall life.

feeds.title: Life with Mar
feeds.description: Arizona fashion & lifestyle blogger sharing everyday outfit ideas, beauty tips, motherhood and style tips.

feeds.title: Eclectic Momsense
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kelly. A wife, mom, and jane of all trades. Just a little bit crafty, a smidgen of all things green, and a huge helping of everything mom! I began this endeavor as a way to chronicle family memories.

feeds.title: Arizona Foothills Magazine
feeds.description: Arizona Foothills Magazine, a gorgeous, high-end publication, is an upscale lifestyle magazine that reaches affluent, well-educated readers in the prestigious desert foothills communities of Arizona.

feeds.title: Diana Elizabeth Blog
feeds.description: Diana Elizabeth is a Phoenix-based lifestyle blogger and photographer. Her blog covers a variety of topics, including home, garden, entertaining, style, and personal. She also shares her travel experiences and tips on how to collaborate with brands.

feeds.title: A Cork, Fork, & Passport
feeds.description: Cork, Fork, & Passport is an Arizona-based online lifestyle magazine featuring recipes and dining, wine and spirits, family and luxury travel, home decor, and technology. All food and cocktail recipes are developed in our test kitchen by professional recipe developer, Julie Cohn. As writer and editor of A Cork, Fork, & Passport, Julie brings her personal perspective as a longtime travel agent and mother to all travel features, showcasing unique family and luxury travel ideas.

feeds.title: azfamily.com » Lifestyle and Travel News
feeds.description: Arizona's Family is the premier news and information destination for the Phoenix-metro area, serving nearly 7-million people who call the valley home. Arizona's Family delivers more original content, live breaking stories, and in-depth coverage on issues that matter most to the people of Arizona.
